probes.text: Water floods the Soprano basement, the room where Tony likes to sit and talk business.
A drunken man in Tony's crew stumbles into the Soprano backyard at night and urinates in the swimming pool.
Late at night, Tony sits alone in front of the television watching the old black-and-white gangster picture The Public Enemy.
Chris gets a tip about a benefit concert worth robbing from the eager teenage son of his late boss.

fine_only.text: Tony turns up at Svetlana's apartment to broker peace over his mother's records, and finds Irina staying there.
Svetlana keeps refusing to hand over Livia's old record collection, which Janice insists belongs to her.

probes.text: Jackie Aprile Jr. gets taken along on a collection run from a debtor by one of the older guys.
Adriana decides she has had enough of hostessing at Artie's restaurant and gives up the job.
Driving home from a therapy appointment, Tony is pulled over and ticketed by a cop he cannot charm.
Artie, within Tony's earshot, lets slip just how attracted he has become to Adriana.
Meadow's Columbia roommate is miserable at college, and Noah invites her along to spend time with the two of them.
Meadow's unhappy roommate keeps attaching herself to her and Noah in the dorm, getting in the way of his studying.
One of the young dancers at the Bada Bing has struck up a friendly, chatty rapport with Tony.
A singing Big Mouth Billy Bass is brought into the Bada Bing and mounted on the wall.
Angie says money is tight, but Tony notices a brand new Cadillac sitting in her driveway.
Carmela sits down with a different psychiatrist, an older colleague Melfi has referred her to.
Tony takes a test drive with a saleswoman, sizing up a new car with her in the passenger seat.

10.title: ...To Save Us All from Satan's Power

probes.text: Bobby squeezes into the Santa suit for the Christmas party and makes an awkward, unconvincing job of it.
Meadow's Christmas gift to Tony is a singing rubber fish, and he fakes delight while the family laughs.
In a flashback to a Christmas years earlier, Pussy is oddly touchy about anyone handling his Santa costume.
Paulie and Chris spend a freezing night sheltering inside an abandoned van deep in the woods.
Out among the pines, Paulie fires his gun into the air out of sheer frustration.
Tony drives out with Bobby to go looking for his two men, following a phone call for help.
Carmela, quietly frightened about her health, keeps welling up at the most ordinary, unexpected things.
At the restaurant, Junior stands and sings "Core 'ngrato" while a drunken Meadow heckles him from the crowd.
In session with Melfi, Tony bitterly rails about the "putrid gene" he believes runs in his family.
